references.text: Another mother looking out the window - Michal, Saul's daughter, looks down at David as he dances before the ark of the covenant
Jezebel looks out the window before she is killed, a similar scene with a woman looking out a window
A woman looking through the window uses a similar Hebrew expression for looking through lattice work
Description of the beloved looking in through the window and through the lattice, using the same word for lattice (אשנב)
The continuation of this text where Sisera's mother comforts herself with thoughts of war spoils
Pharaoh's chariots that were delayed when their wheels fell off, a similar theme about delayed chariots
